Technical

Stats

Human_Cultist_Umberlee_Untaken
Untaken are a type of Umberlee follower.

Involvement

Characters with the title Untaken are in the Water Queen's House in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

This is typically used as the lowest title granted to followers of the  Church of Umberlee, and is usually reserved for novices or cooks.
